verdict.rationale: PlayCanvas officially scaffolds Vite + TypeScript projects for the Engine via `create-playcanvas`, which implies typed API definitions an editor can use. It also ships an official VS Code extension for editing scripts locally. Neither source explicitly describes shipped type declarations, a language server, or the completions, diagnostics, and navigation they would provide, so delivery of the story's tooling is only implied. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of bundled TypeScript declarations or an LSP, a documented description of the VS Code extension's completion/diagnostic/navigation features, and independent hands-on corroboration.
